note: Carried by RelayDifference.newPersist (general observable, stencil X ∪ T.stencil, readout bound price_of_readout) and MergeProof.inviting (section basis inputs), packaged as the Cream structure with a Sluggish E. The regular and forced bounds are folded into one E, the forced part entering through the attainment bound rather than a separate E'.

theorem newPersist (hc:C.Makes) (K : G.Simple) (hZ:∀ N p:ℕ,Nonempty (Keeper (C.path.rep N p N).p (C.path.rep N p N).activities)) (hp: Sluggish C (fun j => Real.exp ((C.path.levels.budget j.1).supportExponent))) (hu:∀ i,0  <  u i)(hx:Sluggish C fun i=> (u i.1)⁻¹) (hv:Sluggish C fun i=> ζ d i.1)(hr:∀ i,C.ref d ≤ i → 0 ≤ ζ d i)
    (h:Tucked F d)(ht:∀ᶠ i in FullVolume.mesh,Continuous (F i.1 i.2 0)) : ∃ E:Cutoffs → ℝ, Sluggish C E ∧ ∀ᶠ i in FullVolume.mesh,C.ref d  ≤  i.1 ∧ ∃ Z t Q, Cream C i.1 i.2 d u ζ (F i.1 i.2 0) Z Q t (E i):=by
  classical
  let H := C.path
  let L := C.labels.level d
  let T := C.localSection d
  obtain ⟨X,hX,c,b,hc',hb,H'⟩ := h
  let D := X ∪ T.stencil
  obtain ⟨k,hk,h₁⟩ := price_of_readout C.params L
  obtain ⟨t,ht',h₂⟩ := offmask C d
  let score (j : Cutoffs) := k*c j
  let r (j : Cutoffs) := badCost C d j.1 t (score j) (b j)
  let g (j : Cutoffs) := regCost C j.1 (score j) (c j)
  let M : ℝ := 2*D.card
  let A (j : Cutoffs) := Real.exp ((H.levels.params j.1).supportExponent) ^ (81:ℕ)
  let Att (j : Cutoffs):= A j* Real.exp (162:ℝ)*r j
  let box (j : Cutoffs) := A j*(g j+r j*M)
  let total (j : Cutoffs) := 1 + (box j + score j); let BaseE (j : Cutoffs):=4*(1+(C.path.levels.params j.1).columns)*total j; let E (j : Cutoffs):= BaseE j + Att j*(ζ d j.1)*(u j.1)⁻¹
  have hs : Sluggish C (fun j=> score j):=(Sluggish.const k).mul hc'; have ho:Sluggish C r:= hb.add (((Sluggish.const (C:=C) ((2:ℝ)*t)).mul (borrowed (W:=Opening.seats C d) (seats_slow K))).mul hs); have hA := Sluggish.pow hp 81
  have hm: Sluggish C total := (Sluggish.const (C:=C) (1:ℝ)).add ((hA.mul ((hc'.add (pillars.mul hs)).add (ho.mul (Sluggish.const M)))).add hs)
  refine ⟨E,(((((Sluggish.const (C:=C) (4:ℝ)).mul ((Sluggish.const _).add pillars)).mul hm)).add (((((hA.mul (Sluggish.const _)).mul ho).mul hv)).mul hx)),?_⟩
  filter_upwards [deepen.eventually (cover_tops (C:=C) K D), ht, deepen.eventually_ge_atTop (C.ref d),deepen.eventually (mitt (C:=C) K D),H'] with i hi hP hI hJ hV
  let N:=i.1; let p:=i.2; let z:= D; let o:= (0:Site (C.side N p)); let Y:=regional D o; let C':=C.path.rep N p N; let P:= C.path.levels.budget N; let v':= C.path.levels.clock.forcedAllowance N
  have hY:regional X o ⊆ Y := Finset.image_subset_image Finset.subset_union_left
  obtain ⟨hy,hC,hB,hL⟩:= hV o; have hG:=regular_larger hy hY; have hc'' := bound_larger hC hY; obtain ⟨Z,h,Zr,hK,hV, S,hS,Hx⟩:= saving C hc hI Y (Classical.choice (hZ N p)) (hJ p) (Finset.image_subset_image Finset.subset_union_right) F ⟨hG,hc'',hB,hL⟩ ht' h₂ (score:=score i) (fun z hz => h₁ _ o Y P _ _ (Nat.le_of_succ_le ((hc.stages d).2 N hI).1) ((hc.stages d).2 N hI).2 hG hc'' z hz)
  have hY': (Y.card:ℝ) ≤ D.card:=by exact_mod_cast Finset.card_image_le
  have hp: (coverNumber P.B Y:ℝ) ≤ 81:=by exact_mod_cast hi p; -- exponent.N
  let a:ℝ:= Real.exp (P.supportExponent*coverNumber P.B Y)
  have he : a  ≤  A i:=by unfold a A;rw [← Real.exp_nat_mul]; apply Real.exp_monotone; push_cast;change _ ≤ 81*P.supportExponent;nlinarith only [hp,P.exponent_pos, mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hp P.exponent_pos.le]
  have hf : 0  ≤  v':=(Real.exp_pos _).le; have hz:Real.sqrt v' ≤ 1:=Real.sqrt_le_one.mpr (Extra.Histories.Doors.stain_le (C.path.levels.clock.hatBeta N))
  have hg : 0  ≤  score i := (coeff_pos L _).trans Zr; have hr' : 0 ≤  r i:= add_nonneg hB (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (zero_le_one.trans ht')) (seats_nonneg ..)) hg); have hb:0  ≤  A i:= le_trans (Real.exp_pos _).le he
  have hφ:0  ≤  g i:= add_nonneg hC.1 (mul_nonneg (zero_le_one.trans (C.path.levels.params N).columns_ge) hg)
  have hv: 2*(Y.card:ℝ)*Real.sqrt v' ≤  M:= by
    exact (mul_le_of_le_one_right (mul_nonneg zero_le_two (Nat.cast_nonneg _)) hz).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hY' zero_le_two)
  have hf: quicksilver P Y (g i) (r i) v'  ≤  box i:=by
    change a*g i+2*(Y.card:ℝ)*_* (a*r i)  ≤  A i*(g i+r i*M)
    rw [mul_add (A i)]
    exact add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right he hφ) ((mul_le_mul hv (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right he hr') (mul_nonneg (Real.exp_pos _).le hr') (show 0  ≤  M by unfold M; positivity)).trans_eq (by ring))
  have hU:YM.Push.Local.reservedMass P Y (r i)  ≤  Att i:=by
    unfold YM.Push.Local.reservedMass
    apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ hr'; rw [add_mul,Real.exp_add]; apply mul_le_mul he _ (Real.exp_pos _).le hb; apply Real.exp_monotone; linarith only [hp]
  have hy:0  <  total i:=by
    have hx:0  ≤  M:=by unfold M; positivity
    exact add_pos_of_pos_of_nonneg zero_lt_one (add_nonneg (mul_nonneg hb (add_nonneg hφ (mul_nonneg hr' hx))) hg)
  have hAtt: 0 ≤  Att i:=(mul_nonneg (Real.exp_pos _).le hr').trans hU
  have hE:BaseE i  ≤  E i:=le_add_of_nonneg_right (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hAtt (hr N hI)) (inv_pos.mpr (hu N)).le)
  refine ⟨hI,Z,box i,total i,h,Extra.Histories.rem_mono hK hf, (add_le_add_left Zr _).trans (le_trans (add_comm ..).le (le_add_of_nonneg_left zero_le_one)),hy,hE, ⟨S,Att i,stackFee hS hU,?_,Hx⟩,hV,hP⟩
  have hO:= hu N
  apply le_trans _ (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (show BaseE i + Att i*ζ d N*(u N)⁻¹ ≤ E i from le_rfl) hO.le)
  have hm: 0  ≤  BaseE i:=mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (add_nonneg zero_le_one (zero_le_one.trans (C.path.levels.params _).columns_ge))) hy.le
  rw [mul_add,show u N * (Att i*ζ d N*(u N)⁻¹)=Att i*ζ d N from by field_simp]
  exact le_add_of_nonneg_left (mul_nonneg hO.le hm)

proof_context.conclusion: For a tucked trial observable, with stencil enlarged by the section stencil, a Sluggish E exists such that eventually there is a one-mark representation Cream with the readout bound from price_of_readout and support weight exp(supportExponent)^81 from cover_tops, all bounds <= E.

    (ha:0 < u N)(hz:0  ≤  ζ d N) (c:Keeper (C.path.rep N p N).p (C.path.rep N p N).activities)

    let E:=4*(1+(C.path.levels.params N).columns)*Q + Real.exp (((K).supportExponent+2)*81)*s*(ζ d N)*(u N)⁻¹

      have he:= BasisCost.analytic V R x o (hb R rfl rfl _ o); rw [show L.coeffSize x=1 from Size.size_axis .., mul_one] at he; exact he
   have hT:(C.path.levels.budget N).Regular (T'.footprint o) (T'.places (L.coords z) o) ∧ R.supBounds o (T'.footprint o) (T'.places (L.coords z) o) J.columns:=by
      have he:= BasisCost.analytic T' R x o (h.priced d N p hN 0); rw [show L.coeffSize x=1 from Size.size_axis ..,mul_one] at he; rw [show L.coords z = a from L.coords.apply_symm_apply _]; exact he

(mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg zero_le_two hw) (seats_nonneg ..))
   have hPt :0 ≤ c':= add_nonneg hv (zero_le_one.trans J.columns_ge)

   have hc' : L.scaled t' (L.coords z)=x:= by rw [show L.coords z=a from L.coords.apply_symm_apply _]; exact L.scaled_inv R.threshold_pos.ne' _
   obtain ⟨Y,hY,ht,Hx,hx,hF⟩:= presses N d p M o y c h hN z he' hc (BasisCost.price_pos T') (fun v _ i U=> BasisCost.full T' v i U) hr.1 (regular_larger hQ.1 hE) (mul_nonneg hi (show 0  ≤  v from Opening.seats_nonneg ..)) hα (score:=1) (show L.coeffSize (L.scaled t' (L.coords z))  ≤  1 from hc'.symm ▸ (Size.size_axis ..).le) (bound_sub (regular_larger hQ.1 hE) (regular_larger hT.1 hc) (bound_larger hQ.2 hE) (bound_larger hT.2 hc)) -- wrong equality
